policies.directoryHint: Lets accounts from the Authentik LDAP outpost log in on Fedora and Debian. The reading account and its password reach every device of this group.
policies.mountsHint: SMB shares appear at login in /media, as USER-folder, with the login password. This needs accounts from a directory.

nextcloudModes.client: Sync client: files are copied to the device

policies.directoryCaHint: Only this CA is trusted for the directory. Do not use the Hauswart CA: a hacked server could then log in as anyone.
policies.appsHint: Rules per Linux user. Everyone else on the device is left alone. They need fapolicyd, which the device installs.
policies.appDownloads: No programs from home or temporary folders
